reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch, following Michaelis, read the two overseer totals as one workforce classified differently, since both figures sum to 3,850.

discrepancy.note: Wellhausen treats Chronicles' multitude of numerical discrepancies with Samuel-Kings as a general feature of the book, of which this overseer count is one instance.

quotes.text: the problem still really was, as before, how to explain the complete difference of general conception and the multitude of discrepancies in details
quotes.attr: Julius Wellhausen (d. 1918), Prolegomena to the History of Israel (1885), on the multitude of discrepancies between Chronicles and the older historical books.

sides.snippet: besides Solomon's chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bore rule over the people who labored in the work.
sides.verseText: besides Solomon's chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bore rule over the people who labored in the work.

sides.snippet: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to set the people at work.
sides.verseText: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to set the people at work.
